# Kubernetes Deployment

This folder contains production-ready baseline manifests for API, frontend, and ingress.

## Prerequisites

1. Kubernetes cluster and `kubectl` access.
2. NGINX ingress controller installed (`ingressClassName: nginx`).
3. TLS certificate secret created in namespace `workflow-agents-prod`:
   - secret name: `workflow-ingress-tls`
4. API and frontend images pushed to a registry.

## Configure and Deploy

1. Build and push images:

```bash
docker build -f Dockerfile.api -t ghcr.io/replace-me/autonomous-workflow-optimization-agents-api:v0.2.0 .
docker build -f frontend/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/replace-me/autonomous-workflow-optimization-agents-frontend:v0.2.0 ./frontend
docker push ghcr.io/replace-me/autonomous-workflow-optimization-agents-api:v0.2.0
docker push ghcr.io/replace-me/autonomous-workflow-optimization-agents-frontend:v0.2.0
```

2. Update [k8s/kustomization.yaml](k8s/kustomization.yaml) image names/tags and update hostnames in:
   - [k8s/api-configmap.yaml](k8s/api-configmap.yaml)
   - [k8s/ingress.yaml](k8s/ingress.yaml)

3. Create the API secret from your real values:

```bash
kubectl create namespace workflow-agents-prod --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl create secret generic workflow-api-secrets \
  --namespace workflow-agents-prod \
  --from-literal=TAVILY_API_KEY='replace_me' \
  --from-literal=WORKFLOW_API_KEY='replace_me' \
  --from-literal=METRICS_API_KEY='replace_me' \
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```

4. Apply manifests:

```bash
kubectl apply -k k8s
```

5. Verify rollout:

```bash
kubectl -n workflow-agents-prod rollout status deploy/workflow-api
kubectl -n workflow-agents-prod rollout status deploy/workflow-frontend
kubectl -n workflow-agents-prod get ingress workflow-ingress
```

## Notes

1. SSE is enabled through ingress annotations in [k8s/ingress.yaml](k8s/ingress.yaml).
2. API `/metrics` requires `X-Metrics-Key` when configured.
3. If your cluster requires image pull secrets, add `imagePullSecrets` to deployment specs.
